npm.desc: Start the website on PORT (default 8080). The pages are built first if they are missing.
Runs by itself before npm start: builds pages/ when it is empty.
Start the website and restart it when app.js, server/ or the Design Studio's swatchroom/server/ change.

Start the Design Studio's local scan models (Python, port 8001) in the foreground. Install their packages first (swatchroom/README.md, step 3); without them scans use Gemini outlines only and the Pick tool does not work.
Rebuild pages/ from pages_original/ and the JSON patches. Run it after a new Claude Design export or a patch change.
Rebuild in memory and report whether the patches still apply and pages/ is current. Writes nothing.
Check every link in the built pages against site/site.json.
Regenerate this page. Run it after adding, removing or changing a file, route or variable, then commit docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.html.
Everything that needs neither a browser nor credentials, in order, with one summary. Add -- --e2e for the browser tests, -- --only js to run one step.
The Design Studio's own unit tests (fusion, the Modal adapters, cold-start, the start-up gate and scan race, ...). None of them calls Modal, Google or a database.
The browser tests: Chrome drives the real pages.

extra.desc: The dev stack: the real site on throw-away settings, as the browser tests use it.
Is it up? Shows the version.
The link check as JSON: which page links to which.
